methodology.fixture: Cold copies of stopped P2C B1 PostgreSQL/OpenSearch; same readonly canonical packs, 11032 works
methodology.load: Four scheduled HTTP searches/s, 80 measured requests in20s, three predefined warmups. Real isolated P2D projection process16/1/1,800 same-source invalidations,5s initial ramp. Benchmark-only delay before bulk, nominal20docs/s; actual rate decides matching. No production scheduler changes.
methodology.pacing: Delay includes document budget, production preparation and HTTP add residual latency; this is not product maximum throughput. Pacing removed after measured window to drain.
methodology.pit: Fresh PIT per request, closed by probe immediately after reading first page. Close excluded from HTTP client timing, included in offered-load schedule. No cursor used after close.
methodology.query_ablation: Only diagnostic fetch wrapper removes aggs. Normal searchWorks/contract/frontend remain unchanged.

queries.fandom: First fandom bucket returned by authoritative default search on the fixed fixture

methodology.spans: Same-request ALS spans: SQL client by purpose; generation filtering plus cursor construction between document lookup completion and next query; Express json call includes serialization/send; finish is server completion, not client receipt. took is nested in OpenSearch client time. Unattributed is per-request wall minus union of spans, never independent percentile subtraction.
methodology.resources: Docker1Hz, Node1Hz event-loop10ms resolution, OpenSearch boundaries and every8 requests (2s). CPU/delta counters cumulative; heap/queue/active/segments are instant sampled gauges. Stats calls add equal observer load. No quotas, cache drop, concurrent build or benchmark.
methodology.overhead: noagg1 and full2 repeat stable post-drain API windows with and without instrumentation, after fresh API restart and warmups. Startup/JIT/order differences limit pure overhead attribution. full1 early overhead window was uninstrumented only and is excluded from paired overhead estimates.
methodology.profiling: Additional profile=true searches after timed windows only; profiling timings are distorted and not substituted for normal latency.
methodology.idle: Initial idle/representative windows have no projection process; API background jobs remain. Full/no-aggs use the same process layout.
methodology.boundaries: Queue and OpenSearch snapshots bracket the wall window by the duration of their own queries. ACK drain and internal indexed counters can differ by partial in-flight bulk; both rates are reported.

limits: Matched document rates do not imply identical GC/segments/cache state; four cold initial clones and reversed order mitigate, do not eliminate, these differences.
No-op reindexing preserves contents; not an ingest or maximum-throughput benchmark.
No sampled queue/rejection does not exclude brief peaks between2s samples.
SQL durations include driver/transport/scheduling; no pure SQL server attribution.
Generation-filter span includes cursor construction and microtask scheduling, not an isolated instruction-level CPU measurement.
No-aggs is a diagnostic counterfactual; facets must be retained in the eventual product change.
OpenSearch contexts sampled after each probe closes its PIT: zero gauges establish cleanup, not zero contexts during the search; probe is serial, at most one test PIT at a time.

configuration.roles: API and projection independent Node processes in the same test application container
configuration.host: Shared Intel i9-13900H,14 CPUs, approximately62.8GiB RAM; no concurrent benchmark/build

diagnosis.p95_interpretation: API and OS P50/P95 are reported separately for each distribution. Never subtract independent percentile values to attribute a component. Per-request stage data retained in runs/windows/samples.
diagnosis.resource_interpretation: Full queries consume31.36/27.33 OS CPU-seconds versus20.04/17.73 without facets over20s at matched rate. No write/search rejections or sampled queue, no old GC or indexing throttle. Higher server took and CPU support genuine search work, not merely HTTP transit. Refresh/merge/young GC also vary; exclusive causality for tail spikes is not established.

p2e2_recommendation.single_intervention: Evaluate bounded two-way partition of the ten independent facet aggregations on the same PIT and exact same filters, merging unchanged facets into the existing response.
p2e2_recommendation.implementation_candidate: Two search bodies in bounded multi-search: one retains current hits/sort/total and a balanced facet subset, the other size0/track_total_hits=false and remaining facets. At most2 simultaneous searches; all-or-nothing response, identical PIT/epoch/filter and each terms definition; no mapping/cache/UI change.
p2e2_recommendation.basis: Profile runs distribute61.90/35.84ms across ten collectors; unclassified19.31/13.06, relationships12.19/6.26 and fandom9.16/5.53ms. Work spans multiple collectors; collection/leaf traversal dominates rather than just ordinal initialization.
p2e2_recommendation.potential_not_demonstrated: Reduce serial aggregation critical path while retaining facets. The measured full/no-aggs gap25.08–25.79ms idle and35.57–42.01ms paced backlog is an upper diagnostic opportunity, NOT a predicted saving. Two-way partition may duplicate traversal and fail to improve.
p2e2_recommendation.correctness: Require complete facet bucket/count/order equality, unchanged hits/order/totals/cursors/generation filtering, same snapshot, error/timeout cleanup; no partial facet response.
p2e2_recommendation.indexing_impact: Additional concurrent traversal/CPU/heap may worsen indexing or search tails. Measure maximum-throughput product workload and matched load; do not ship if gains require unacceptable throughput loss.
p2e2_recommendation.complexity_and_contract: Moderate search orchestration change; query construction changes, API/frontend/mapping/durability do not. No implementation in P2E.1b.
